method.sources: a finished week: Yahoo's block from the latest pull after the week's end, else the box-score rebuild of each team's active slots (pinned lineups, else today's roster); the week in progress: the day's pull
method.cumulative: totals summed over the weeks; FG% and FT% as total makes over total attempts
method.power: all-play: every team against all eleven others on the nine categories each week, TO reversed, a tie half; power = cumulative all-play win rate; luck = actual category win rate (Yahoo's scores) minus the all-play rate
